description: This file defines the 'NoteViewHolder' class, a RecyclerView.ViewHolder implementation used to display individual notes within a list. It manages binding note data to UI components, updating visual indicators, handling content rendering (including markdown), and managing nested adapters for tasks and attachments.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass for displaying note items, handling UI updates, and interactions within a RecyclerView list.

methods.name: updateBackgroundColor
methods.description: Updates the background color of the note item based on its NoteColor.

methods.name: updateTags
methods.description: Updates the display of tags associated with the note, reusing views for efficiency.

methods.name: updateIndicatorIcons
methods.description: Adjusts visibility of various status indicators (hidden, pinned, reminders, deleted, archived) based on note properties.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the note’s title in the UI, hiding it if empty.

methods.name: setTextContent
methods.description: Sets the note’s content in the UI, rendering markdown if enabled.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Displays the note's tasks if it is a list and tasks are present, showing a limited number with a 'more' indicator if needed.

methods.name: setupAttachments
methods.description: Initializes and displays note attachments, handling a maximum of four with a 'show more' indicator.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Updates the view based on a set of payloads indicating what has changed in the note.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the full note data to the ViewHolder, setting all UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: onSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Changes the visual state of the item when selected or deselected.
